entities.name: Jaroslav Pospíšil
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jaroslav Pospíšil is a Czech tennis coach and a former professional player who competed on the ITF Futures and ATP Challenger tours. On 23 May 2011 he reached his highest ATP singles ranking of world No. 103. On 1 October 2012, he reached his best doubles ranking of No. 115.
